content.content:
Found 6 files
README.md
docs/deployment.md
app/(site)/posts-data.ts
app/(site)/posts/[slug]/page.tsx
shared/resolve-translation.ts
AGENTS.md

content.text:
Good news: it's smaller than it probably feels. `shared/resolve-translation.ts` (105 lines) has exactly two matching primitives plus the driver:

- `normalizeLocale` — lowercase/trim so tags compare case-insensitively
- `languageSubtag` — strips the region off (`ja-JP` → `ja`)
- `findExactMatch` — full-tag match
- `findLanguageMatch` — language-only match
- `resolveTranslation` — tries exact across all accepted locales, then language-only across all accepted locales, then the post's `defaultLocale`

The only other locale code is `acceptedLocales()` in `app/(site)/posts/[slug]/page.tsx`, which just parses the `Accept-Language` header into an ordered list (note: it takes entries in header order and does **not** actually sort by `q` value, despite the comment implying it does — worth flagging separately if that's intentional or not).

That's the whole thing — no other locale helpers elsewhere in the repo. Want me to just walk you through resolveTranslation's control flow, or is there a specific part (e.g. the q-value handling, or whether exact/language-match logic could collapse into one parameterized function) you want reviewed or simplified?
